title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct DePauw study settings, from quiet library rooms to technology-equipped collaboration spaces, with current access and reservation guidance.

cards.entity_name: Roy O. West Library Reading Room
cards.title: Settle Into the Two-Story Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Quiet study inside Roy O. West Library
cards.notes: Bring reading-heavy work and choose a seat in the 3,280-square-foot room; confirm that day’s library hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A large, purpose-built quiet room with books, wood detailing and expansive views.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw identifies the 3,280-square-foot Reading Room as a space that fosters quiet study inside Roy O. West Library.
cards.source_title: Roy O. West Library Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Located inside Roy O. West Library; consult the library website for current daily hours. No separate reservation rule is stated for the Reading Room.

cards.entity_name: Roy O. West Library Treehouse Study Area
cards.title: Work From a Refurbished Treehouse Desk
cards.subtitle: An individual-work setting preserved in Roy O.
cards.notes: Use a treehouse desk for focused individual work, and check the library’s current hours before relying on evening access.
cards.short_summary: A distinctive set of elevated individual desks retained through the library renovation.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw reports that Roy O. West Library’s recognizable treehouse desks were refurbished and remain in the renovated building.
cards.access_notes: Inside Roy O. West Library and subject to current library hours; the source does not identify a reservation process for these desks.

cards.entity_name: Roy O. West Library Private Study Rooms
cards.title: Reserve a Room for Group Work
cards.subtitle: Private rooms with a student reservation option
cards.notes: Use the library’s Student Room Reservations link before a group session; verify room availability and current building hours online.
cards.short_summary: Enclosed rooms support conversations and project work away from open seating.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw says Roy O. West Library has 16 study rooms and provides a Student Room Reservations service.
cards.access_notes: Student reservations are available through the library website. Availability and current library hours should be checked before arrival.

cards.title: Build a Tech-Heavy Work Session
cards.subtitle: High-tech collaboration in Roy O. West Library
cards.notes: Bring computing or visualization work here, then confirm whether your planned equipment requires guidance, training or advance coordination.
cards.short_summary: A technology-centered workspace available to students from every discipline.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw describes the Tenzer Technology Center as a high-tech collaborative space in Roy O. West Library whose services are available to the entire DePauw community.
cards.access_notes: Located in Roy O. West Library and available to the DePauw community; consult the center or library for current hours and equipment conditions.

cards.title: Spread Out in Harrison’s Shared Atrium
cards.subtitle: Open collaboration space in the School of Business and Leadership
cards.notes: Choose the atrium for collaborative work, but check for scheduled events because DePauw also uses this shared space for gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A bright, shared setting near research terminals and flexible learning rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw states that renovated Harrison Hall includes a shared atrium, Bloomberg terminals, a case-study room and flexible collaboration classrooms.
cards.access_notes: DePauw’s Spring 2026 finals page listed Harrison among card-access classroom buildings open Monday–Thursday, 7 a.m.–midnight; ordinary-term access may differ.

cards.entity_name: Percy L. Julian Science and Mathematics Center Atrium
cards.title: Meet Around the Julian Atrium
cards.subtitle: A spacious science-building study setting
cards.notes: Use the atrium for a science problem set or small-group review, and bring your student card when evening building access may require it.
cards.short_summary: An open academic-building atrium intended for studying with fellow students.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw identifies the Julian Science and Mathematics Center’s spacious atrium as a place for studying with fellow students.
cards.access_notes: DePauw’s Spring 2026 finals page listed Julian among card-access classroom buildings open Monday–Thursday, 7 a.m.–midnight; regular access may differ.

cards.title: Read With a Small Group in Bennett Library
cards.subtitle: CDI Room 204 for two to six people
cards.notes: Plan a quiet session for no more than six people, then follow the CDI reservation process if you need the room held for your group.
cards.short_summary: A compact reading-and-study room inside the Center for Diversity and Inclusion.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw lists Bennett Library in CDI Room 204 as a reading and study space with capacity for two to six people.
cards.access_notes: The CDI page provides a reservation process. DePauw’s virtual tour says the CDI is open to the DePauw community daily from 8 a.m. to midnight.

cards.title: Map Ideas on the Mobile Whiteboard
cards.subtitle: A 12-person reservable study room in the CDI
cards.notes: Reserve Room 202 for a working session that benefits from a mobile whiteboard and display; keep the group within its stated capacity.
cards.short_summary: A presentation-ready group room with movable writing space.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw lists CDI Room 202 as a 12-person Student Study Space equipped with a mobile whiteboard and flat-panel display.
cards.access_notes: Use the CDI reservation process. The center’s virtual tour states daily DePauw-community access from 8 a.m. to midnight.

cards.title: Take an Ethics Reading List to Wood Library
cards.subtitle: A focused collection inside the Prindle Institute
cards.notes: Bring ethics research or seminar preparation to the library, and account for the Nature Park location when planning travel time.
cards.short_summary: A subject-focused library surrounded by Prindle’s meeting and research spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw states that the Wood Library at the Janet Prindle Institute for Ethics contains more than 1,500 ethics books and related publications.
cards.source_title: The Janet Prindle Institute for Ethics Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: DePauw’s Spring 2026 finals page listed Prindle Institute study access Monday–Thursday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; check current institute access before traveling.

cards.title: Pair Study Time With Tutor Feedback
cards.subtitle: Writing, quantitative and speaking support in Roy O.
cards.notes: Book an appointment when you want structured feedback, and select an in-person or eligible remote session through the scheduling system.
cards.short_summary: A staffed academic-work space for targeted writing, quantitative and speaking help.
cards.evidence_claim: DePauw locates The Learning Commons in Roy O. West Library Room 101 and says its W, Q and S tutors offer practical feedback by appointment.
cards.access_notes: Appointments are made through DePauw’s WCOnline system. Most sessions are in person; Writing and Speaking also offer remote options.
